name: Imagecrafter — "Choose a creature type. Target creature becomes that type"
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (theme: becomes that type). The fired ability produced nothing, and the sister wording 'becomes the creature type of your choice' (Mistform cycle) wiped the creature's subtypes. A fired ability whose text chooses a creature type now carries the creature-type input; choosing writes the type into the text ('becomes a Goblin') and re-parses, keeping the source pin and any picked target. Imagecrafter turns the Bears into a Goblin; Mistform Dreamer turns itself into an Elf; Hill Giant is untouched.

call: Choose a creature type other than Wall. Target creature becomes that type until end of turn.
